# Innovation Architecture

This file is the index. The cards live in `resources/`, one file per phase.

Choosing starts from what you are trying to learn. If you do not yet know the customer's problem, read Customer Discovery. If you have a candidate direction and need to know which assumption would sink it, read Hypothesis Framing. If the bet is on a solution, read Prototyping and Smoke Testing. If the bet is live and the numbers must decide, read Metrics and Accounting. Then take the one card whose hypothesis states a threshold you can actually measure this week.

When two cards fit, prefer the one whose threshold you can reach before the phase ends. A test without a reachable threshold is a meeting.

Routes out of this deck. The pivot decision (I42) also appears as story and as after-action in the Narrative and Retrospective decks: those own the telling and the review, this card owns the accounting and its kill criteria. PMF and NPS (I34, I35) sit near the Strategy deck's North Star metric trees: strategy owns the metric tree, this card owns the survey and its threshold. The smoke-test archetypes (I21-I24) use names the Archetypal deck also uses; that deck names voices, this one names experiments, and they do not overlap.

Rules that hold across every card:

- State the threshold before you run the test. A hypothesis whose validation criterion is written afterwards is a story about the result.
- Read the named false positive before you read the result. Every test in this deck has a way of lying to you, and it is on the card.
- One threshold at a time. Two success criteria in one experiment means neither can fail cleanly.
- The method strip is the cost of knowing. If the time or the money is more than the decision is worth, the card is the wrong card.
- Compression is the card's limit, not the source's. Read the full stages and the full warning here before arguing from the card.
- A named origin is the source's, not the card's. The card text, thresholds and warnings are the source's words or this deck's compression of them.
